description: Read the AI inbox: what happened on your connected LinkedIn accounts (messages received and sent, new relations, account status changes and checkpoints), in your shared inbox (inbox.* events) and on your X account (x.message_*), oldest first, kept 30 days. Pass query.after = the next value from your last read to see only what is new, query.event to filter, query.since for a time. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /linkedin/webhooks/inbox, group webhooks.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
